##### Project general facts

Element by Iman is a residential tower, built around the idea of art expressed through curves. Flowing lines, sculpted edges and elegantly layered terraces shape the façade, while rounded corners and sweeping balconies with glass balustrades give the building a soft, sculptural silhouette. The collection includes studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, layouts with a study, and three-bedroom duplexes with private pools, complemented by retail units at street level.

The rooftop is conceived as a shared leisure deck, centred on an infinity-edge pool lined with sun loungers and framed by city views. A shaded lounge with deep sofas and olive trees sits along the water, creating a calm setting for relaxation and gatherings. Selected duplex residences extend onto private terraces with their own plunge pools, while basement levels provide secure parking for residents.

Inside, warm tones and tactile finishes carry the curved architecture into every residence. Light and shadow play across textured surfaces, and floor-to-ceiling glazing draws natural light deep into the living areas. Soft neutral palettes and open layouts create interiors that feel balanced, comfortable and calm, giving residents a refined backdrop for everyday living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Science Park is a dedicated business and residential community set along Umm Suqeim Street, between Al Barsha South, Arjan and Dubai Miracle Garden. The district combines office campuses, research facilities and residential towers in a well-planned urban setting, with Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road running close by.

The area enjoys direct links to the city's main road corridors, giving quick access to Mall of the Emirates, Hessa Street, Dubai Marina and Ibn Battuta Mall. Global Village, Dubai Autodrome and Dubai Miracle Garden offer leisure options nearby, while Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International airports remain within comfortable driving distance. Schools, clinics and everyday retail are spread across the surrounding communities.

Positioned as a hub for companies in the science, health and energy sectors, Dubai Science Park draws a steady pool of professionals who prefer to live close to work. This built-in demand, together with central connectivity and access to established neighbouring communities, supports the district's appeal for both end users and investors seeking rental-focused residential property.
